subject: Split-crate delivery + short-term warehouse hold for SFO event
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@pacificdrayage.com>; Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@moscone.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Split-crate delivery + short-term warehouse hold for SFO event

Hi Sara / Tom,

Quick heads up — our booth shipment for SaaS Summit West was booked as a single shipment but Pacific Drayage indicates the carrier split the load into two crates (Container A & Container B). The Moscone team said they can accept on-site but we need to confirm arrival windows.

Questions: 
- Can Pacific provide confirmed arrival dates/times for both crates?
- If Container B arrives later than Container A, can you arrange short-term hold at your SFO inbound warehouse (up to 48–72 hours)? We may not be able to assemble both crates same day.
- Please include estimated drayage + storage per crate so I can sign off.

I've attached the manifest and the initial BOL for Container A. If holding is required we'll sign the authorization (please send a short authorization PDF we can sign).

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: BOL_ContainerA_73821.pdf, crate_manifest_SaaS_Summit_0606.xlsx

From: Sara Lopez <sara@pacificdrayage.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Split-crate delivery + short-term warehouse hold for SFO event

Hi Hannah / Dylan,

Thanks for the details. Confirming receipt of the manifest. Quick summary from our ops desk: 
- Container A (BOL 73821) is inbound and currently scheduled to arrive SFO terminal on Thu 6/3, expected gate-in at our inbound yard Fri 6/4 AM.
- Container B was unloaded at origin due to weight distribution and is now on a separate truck with an updated ETA for Tue 6/8 (delayed by origin rework).

We can hold Container A at our SFO inbound warehouse for up to 72 hours at $95/day per crate; drayage from yard to Moscone is $420/crate (standard). If you need longer than 72 hours we can arrange extended storage at the bonded facility — rate changes will apply.

Attached: signed-drayage-authorization.pdf (we filled the docket with provisional charges; please initial + return)

Next steps suggested:
1) Authorize hold up to 72 hours for Container A (reply with approval and your max daily spend).
2) We will provide a pickup window for Moscone (once you confirm the show move-in date/time).

If you want us to reroute Container A directly to an alternate warehouse (WestCoast Logistics), we can do that but it adds ~$150 one-time handling.

—Sara
Sara Lopez
Operations Manager
Pacific Drayage Co.
sara@pacificdrayage.com | 415-222-9104

Attachments: signed-drayage-authorization.pdf

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Sara Lopez <sara@pacificdrayage.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Split-crate delivery + short-term warehouse hold for SFO event

Thanks Sara — Hannah and I spoke briefly. Hannah: please authorize the 72-hour hold and cap storage spend at $150/day total (both crates combined) — we want to avoid unexpected costs.

Dev: FYI — if Container B slips past Tue 6/8 we may need your routing help to move A to WestCoast Logistics (alternate warehouse) to free up our staging window at Moscone. Can you confirm whether WestCoast can accept a crate on short notice and whether that will impact our inbound insurance?

Sara: authorize hold per Dylan's cap and confirm when you need the signed authorization back. If you can leave the authorization editable we can e-sign and return today.

-Dylan
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-2041

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Sara Lopez <sara@pacificdrayage.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Split-crate delivery + short-term warehouse hold for SFO event

On Wed, Jun 2, 2026 at 08:34 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Sara — Hannah and I spoke briefly...

Hannah / Dylan — WestCoast Logistics (ops@westcoastlogistics.com) confirmed they can accept one crate with 24 hours notice. They'll charge a $120 inbound handling fee plus standard storage if we hold beyond their free 24-hour staging. Our insurance broker confirmed coverage will remain intact as long as the consignee remains 'Redwood Inference' and we list the storage facility on the manifest. I'll handle the manifest update and provide the amended delivery address if we decide to reroute.

I'll also prepare a short fallback plan:
- Primary: Hold Container A at Pacific Drayage for up to 72 hours (approve now).
- Fallback: If Container B ETA slips beyond 6/9, reroute A to WestCoast Logistics and pay one-time $150 handling + $120 inbound.

Sara: please proceed to hold under the $150/day cap. I will sign the authorization electronically and circulate the updated manifest to all.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Program Operations
dev.patel@redwood.ai

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Split-crate delivery + short-term warehouse hold for SFO event

Sara — thank you. This is approved: hold Container A for up to 72 hours, cap storage spend at $150/day total. We will e-sign the authorization now (attached) and return. Please confirm:
- Exact deadline/time for pick-up from your warehouse before we incur long-term storage charges.
- Final pickup window for delivery to Moscone once both crates are ready.

Tom — FYI: Moscone team, please hold the move-in window option open for late afternoon 6/9 if Container B clears customs early; otherwise we'll coordinate with you to schedule off-hour unload.
